title: Running devkb init again deleted part of my AGENTS.md
body:
**What I did:** I had added my own notes to AGENTS.md below the section devkb manages. While editing, I accidentally deleted the last line of devkb's section (the one that closes it). Then I ran `devkb init` again.

**What I got:** everything I had written below that point was gone. Running `devkb init --remove` afterwards removed even more.

**What I expected:** devkb should never delete text I wrote. If it cannot tell where its own section ends, it should leave the file alone and tell me which file and line to fix.
